newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar maintains rise by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar maintains rise by close.

text.p: White sugar futures kept most of their gains by the close on Wednesday as the market rebounded from this week's sharp fall on fund-led long liquidation, traders said.
The fund selling spree on August seemed to be dwindling although light August selling was still seen in the afternoon.
Trade buying was supportive at the lows and August pushed higher from its $315.20 intraday low to a session peak and previous support at $320.00.
Overall volume, centred on August, amounted to 3,159 lots.
The weakness in August whites had been expected to prompt some buying of the August/July arbitrage but little of this was reported as New York put in a lacklustre performance, traders said.
"Neither market seems to be too active," said one.

On Tuesday, persistent commission house selling of August squeezed August/October through support at $4.00 but August's slight recovery on Wednesday afternoon dragged the differential back to the $3.00 mark.
